title: Renew trader's plates
summary: Find out how to renew your trader's plates by visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
A trader's plate renewal invitation is sent to all existing trader's plate holders in late November of each year. All trader's plates have a common expiry date of 31 December.

If you want to renew your plate(s), please visit a Service NSW Centre. If they're not renewed within 3 months of the expiry date, they're automatically cancelled.
what_you_need: Compulsory third party (CTP) insurance that specifies the plates are being renewed (insurance must expire 31 December of the following year)

how_to_steps.text: Make sure you have the required documents and your trader's plate(s).
Visit a service centre and provide the information in person.

external_links.text: Form 1728: Trader's Plate Conditions of Use – PDF
Motor Dealers Guide to Vehicle Registration – Transport for NSW

internal_links.text: Apply for an additional trader's plate

faqs.q: When are trader's plate renewal invitations sent?
faqs.a: Renewal invitations are sent to all existing plate holders in late November each year.

faqs.q: What happens if I don't renew my plates?
faqs.a: If the plates are not renewed within 3 months of the expiry date, they are automatically cancelled.

faqs.q: Where do I renew my trader's plates?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to renew your plates.
